tasks.label: deploy_usb
args: set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -d /Volumes/CIRCUITPY ] || [ ! -f /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/boot_out.txt ]; then printf '%s\n' 'CIRCUITPY is not mounted. Reset the board and hold the button while the NeoPixel is blue.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f settings.toml ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Local settings.toml is missing. Create it from settings.toml.example before deploying.' >&2; exit 1; fi; cp settings.toml /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/settings.toml; cp thresholds.py /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/thresholds.py; cp boot.py /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/boot.py; rsync -av --exclude='._*' --exclude='__pycache__/' --include='*/' --include='*.py' --exclude='*' reporters/ /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/reporters/; cp code.py /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/code.py; sync

tasks.label: add_deps
args: set -euo pipefail; for source in ./code.py ./reporters/*.py; do npm run --silent circup -- install --auto --auto-file "$source"; done; npm run --silent circup -- freeze -r

tasks.label: add_deps_usb
args: set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -d /Volumes/CIRCUITPY ] || [ ! -f /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/boot_out.txt ]; then printf '%s\n' 'CIRCUITPY is not mounted. Reset the board and hold the button while the NeoPixel is blue.' >&2; exit 1; fi; for source in ./code.py ./reporters/*.py; do circup --path /Volumes/CIRCUITPY install --auto --auto-file "$source"; done; circup --path /Volumes/CIRCUITPY freeze -r
